title: Motivation and procrastination
learning_outcomes: Explain avoidance in the context of motivation and procrastination.
Compare and distinguish task decomposition in the context of motivation and procrastination.
Apply if-then plans in the context of motivation and procrastination.
Evaluate and justify decisions about barrier review in the context of motivation and procrastination.

lessons.title: Avoidance
lessons.outcome: Explain avoidance in the context of motivation and procrastination.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving avoidance; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Create an annotated explanation with a concrete example and a counterexample. Connect the result to procrastination experiment.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain avoidance from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of avoidance; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Task decomposition
lessons.outcome: Compare and distinguish task decomposition in the context of motivation and procrastination.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving task decomposition; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Compare two cases or approaches using explicit criteria; identify an important limitation. Connect the result to procrastination experiment.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain task decomposition from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of task decomposition; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: If-then plans
lessons.outcome: Apply if-then plans in the context of motivation and procrastination.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving if-then plans; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Work through a new case or simulation; document assumptions and steps. Connect the result to procrastination experiment.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain if-then plans from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of if-then plans; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Barrier review
lessons.outcome: Evaluate and justify decisions about barrier review in the context of motivation and procrastination.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving barrier review; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Analyse an unfamiliar case; defend a choice, identify uncertainty and revise after feedback. Connect the result to procrastination experiment.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain barrier review from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of barrier review; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

criteria.criterion: Accurate explanation of avoidance; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of task decomposition; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of if-then plans; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of barrier review; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

assessment.threshold: All mapped criteria at level 2; no averaging away missing criteria. Level 3 requires independent novel application, delayed reassessment and appropriate review.
assessment.alternate_evidence: Equivalent accessible written, oral, visual, simulated or supervised evidence; no personal disclosure required.

safety.notes: Draft educational framework only. Use fictional cases; no personal diagnosis, prescription, hazardous practice, financial/legal instruction or unqualified certification. Obtain qualified/local review before publication.
